---
title: "Peer-reviewed Publications"
---
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

from bibtexparser import parse_file

library = parse_file("my_pubs.bib")

peer_reviewed = [
    e for e in library.entries
    if "peer-reviewed" in e["keywords"]
]

peer_reviewed.sort(
    key=lambda e: int(e["year"]),
    reverse=True
)

for entry in peer_reviewed:

    title = (
        entry["title"]
        .replace("{", "")
        .replace("}", "")
        .replace("\\textsc", "")
    )

    authors = (
        entry["author"]
        .replace(" and ", ", ")
        .replace("{", "")
        .replace("}", "")
    )

    venue = ""

    if "journal" in entry:
        venue = entry["journal"]
    elif "booktitle" in entry:
        venue = entry["booktitle"]

    year = entry["year"] if "year" in entry else ""
    doi = entry["doi"] if "doi" in entry else ""

    print(f"**{title}**  ")
    print(f"{authors}  ")

    if venue:
        print(f"*{venue}* ({year})  ")

    if doi:
        print(f"<https://doi.org/{doi}>")

    print()
```
